description:
I added code to automatically center the point labels when using a polar graph.
This solves the issue of #9662

comments.body:
centerPointLabels or centerLabels would be a more logical name to me since its implemented on scale level the radar chart could also use it (if wanted for some reason)

Also it cant be true by default. This will make it a breaking change
Why replace the createContext function with the same logic as that is in the function?
Since you only expect a singel value as extra argument it would be better for performance to just pass that value instead of a object that has to be destructured.

I changed the option name to `centerPointLabels`.
Also, I changed the default value to false.

Sorry. I did't mean to change it.
I reverted it back.
I changed the argument to a single value.
